scope: Whole-function native indexed writes and shared VM value update routine
reproduction: VM/interpreter passed the regression; compiling hot array_write failed in legacy integer-dictionary lowering. Whole-function writes incorrectly used caller-slot helpers/pointer caches rather than callee bindings.
implementation: Carry BytecodeBindingKind metadata into every native translator entrypoint.
Resolve indexed write targets to callee SSA roots or named locals, reject immutable/const mutation, decode typed operands and propagate errors before later effects.

Share the existing VM indexed-write body; canonicalized extraction comparison verifies only four dispatcher error paths became Result returns, plus formatting. Byte writes use the same existing validated helper.
Remove caller-slot integer-dictionary pointer initialization from whole functions. Release consumed index/value roots and emit a tagged Null result.

cases: Array and byte writes with negative indices
Integer-key and string-key dictionaries with owned values
Let/const mutation failures after native warmup
Byte range and array bounds failures skip later effects; subsequent valid calls recover
verification.cost: 1000 native writes reuse the unique array buffer; a snapshot forces normal COW and remains unchanged. Compiled8/128 writes retain at most4 root slots of capacity, zero live roots after return, empty VM stack and unchanged caller sentinel.
verification.format: cargo fmt --check and git diff --check passed

limitations: Specialized integer-dictionary loop helpers remain separately gated and need audit
Fused append-until, general owned constant/argument entry and recursive lifetime work remain open
Existing FixedDict write implementation retained; this extraction is not a claim that all representation costs are eliminated
